entries.subject: Cassini projected outline and JPL size estimate
entries.finding: Cassini / Porco et al. (2003) reports a 150 × 120 km projected outline (±20 km) near 70° phase. The display uses that 1.25 ratio and equal short axes, normalizing volume to JPL’s 85 ± 10 km radius; derived semiaxes 98.63 × 78.91 × 78.91 km are not three measured axes or a reconstruction of Cassini’s viewing geometry.

entries.subject: Preliminary large occultation ellipse
entries.finding: Gomes-Júnior’s 2021 analysis rejects the preliminary roughly 200 × 150 km ellipse using negative chords and Cassini evidence. Combining the May 2018 events suggests an 85 km equatorial radius, with a possible crater and 3D solution still unresolved. The 205.6 × 141.3 km secondary-catalog outline is not adopted and no speculative crater is rendered.
entries.revisitWhen: A published shape solution supplies a documented three-dimensional model and body frame.

entries.subject: Pinned independent orbital observations
entries.finding: Selected vector-epoch evidence constrains the documented orbit correction, not a surface map.

entries.subject: Cassini N1355869401 native-frame inspection
entries.finding: The OPUS survey returned 93 matches and retained the first 12. The finest-distance calibrated native N1355869401 (CL1/CB3, 8.2-second exposure, about 26.60 km/pixel) was inspected but does not establish a securely registered disc. Exact raster hash and original label are retained.
entries.revisitWhen: A registered mapped release supports a defined lens.

entries.subject: Denk et al. (2026) Cassini and New Horizons review
entries.finding: Section 4.3.3 and Figure 20 examine shorter Cassini exposures in seven filters: about 4–6 pixels across with no unambiguous surface spots. New Horizons 2007 views are barely resolved. Integrated colors are not a spatial color or composition map.
entries.revisitWhen: A source observation or validated reconstruction resolves independently registered surface information beyond these sampling limits.

entries.subject: Registered DEM and geology search
entries.finding: No registered DEM or mapped geological release was qualified in the documented survey. This is a bounded search result, not evidence that no future source can exist.
entries.revisitWhen: A primary release supplies downloadable Himalia mapped data with coordinates, quantity and coverage.
